name: K35 Wireless Microphone – High-Quality 2.4GHz Lapel Mic Set with 3.5mm Receiver for Mobile Phones, Cameras, Speakers & Vlogging
description: Elevate your audio quality with the K35 High-Quality Wireless Dual Microphone System. Specifically engineered for content creators, vloggers, interviewers, and educators, this premium dual-microphone kit ensures professional, crystal-clear sound delivery across two speakers simultaneously. The setup comes with two lightweight lapel transmitters and a versatile 3.5mm receiver, making it perfectly compatible with DSLR cameras, smartphones, laptops, portable speakers, and audio mixers.Powered by advanced 2.4GHz wireless transmission technology, the K35 system provides an ultra-stable, lag-free signal up to a range of 20 meters. It features a complete plug-and-play setup—the transmitters and receiver pair automatically instantly upon power-up, eliminating the hassle of complex Bluetooth configurations or third-party application downloads. Inside, high-fidelity digital silicon microphones work alongside a built-in intelligent noise reduction chip to block out disruptive environmental background sounds, capturing voice with exceptional depth and clarity.Equipped with a high-capacity rechargeable battery system, the microphones deliver up to 8 hours of continuous operation on a single charge. Whether you are conducting a dual interview, recording a podcast, live streaming, or teaching a class, the K35 system provides the mobility and pristine audio quality required to stand out.Product FeaturesDual-Transmitter Recording: Includes two separate clip-on lapel microphones, letting you record two people at the same time with excellent balance.Instant Auto-Pairing Setup: True plug-and-play design connects the transmitters to the receiver immediately when turned on—no Bluetooth or app required.Universal 3.5mm Connectivity: The receiver is fitted with a standard 3.5mm audio jack, making it compatible with cameras, speakers, PCs, and laptops.Intelligent Background Noise Cancellation: Advanced digital silicon mic components and chip filtering isolate ambient sound to deliver crisp vocal delivery.Extended 20-Meter Range: Operates seamlessly over a 20-meter open line-of-sight range without audio dropping out or distorting.
